source: By construction, confirmed by `ale validate`'s oracle pass: validate-c4458a44 (2026-11-24, engine bfb7505, a clean checkout of aaf26432 made with umask 022): dual_mode_score 1.0 = (offline reward 1.0 + online reward 1.0) / 2. The offline item graded the reference program frozen at the graded start (2 files: rescue.py and the oracle token) on the 8 hidden sites as main does: rescue_score 1.0 (located, kit and returned 1.0 on every site, no void, no rerun; 700.8 s simulated per site on average; 1481 s of offline grading), ratio 1.0 to main's anchor (tests/anchor_offline.json); the online item scored the graded episode ep04: rescue_score 1.0 (683.0 s simulated, 266 s of wall clock in the privileged reference run), ratio 1.0 to tests/anchor_online.json. Untouched: 0.0 (no record, the empty session-end submission). Each item is normalised by its own measured anchor, so an oracle that reaches both anchors scores 1.0.
note: dual mode (experimental): reward = (offline reward + online reward) / 2, each the item's unrounded reward (robotics_grader.ratio_rewards against its own anchor, cap 1.5 and full_at 0.98); the mean is written through ratio_rewards once more against this anchor with cap 1.0 and full_at 1.0, so the reward is the mean itself. The offline item grades the program frozen at the earlier of the graded start and the start window's close (or at the session's end when the session ends before the window closes, without a start) exactly as main does; the online item scores the graded episode's record.
